narrative.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Greater Adept's Robe, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
narrative.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
narrative.offerRewardText: My new robe! Delightful! At long last, I can don my robe AND my wizard hat.
narrative.requestItemsText: <Magus Tirth begins to cast Polymorph: Chicken on you.>
